My guess is that you are using Alsa sound drivers. I haven't found a simple way to change defaults yet and it irritates the living shit out of me because it doesn't seem to auto change when you plug headphones in either, you have to change it manually every fucking time. There is most likely a tool to use for this but I haven't come across it yet. Alsamixer simply changes volume and channels and doesn't even seem to offer the option of changing your default.

But the long way around to change this is to edit /usr/share/alsa/alsa.conf and scroll down to the line that says 'defaults.ctl.card' and change that value to the card that you want to use. You need to change both that one and the value below it called 'defaults.pcm.card'. In my experience so far you will also need to restart whatever program you are using.

Another way to set the default on a per user level, this is useful if you cannot get root access for some reason or another, is to create a file in your home directory called '.asoundrc' and enter the following text into it:

pcm.!default {

type hw

card 0

}

ctl.!default {

type hw

card 0

}

Change that value of 0 to the correct value that you need.

If you're using Pulseaudio however, I haven't used it much myself and wouldn't know how to help.
